package internalapi

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

type exactLearningPathReplanRequest struct {
	Schema               string                    `json:"schema"`
	PlanningRequestID    string                    `json:"planning_request_id"`
	CourseID             string                    `json:"course_id"`
	GoalCode             string                    `json:"goal_code"`
	CourseFingerprint    string                    `json:"course_fingerprint"`
	PlannerPolicyVersion string                    `json:"planner_policy_version"`
	ReasonCode           string                    `json:"reason_code"`
	ReasonSummary        string                    `json:"reason_summary"`
	ExpectedVersion      int64                     `json:"expected_version"`
	Items                []domain.LearningPathItem `json:"items,omitempty"`
}

type exactLearningPathNoGapRequest struct {
	Schema               string `json:"schema"`
	PlanningRequestID    string `json:"planning_request_id"`
	CourseID             string `json:"course_id"`
	GoalCode             string `json:"goal_code"`
	CourseFingerprint    string `json:"course_fingerprint"`
	PlannerPolicyVersion string `json:"planner_policy_version"`
	ReasonCode           string `json:"reason_code"`
	ReasonSummary        string `json:"reason_summary"`
	ExpectedVersion      int64  `json:"expected_version"`
}

func (h *Handler) GetLearningPathPlanningState(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.LearningPathPlanning == nil {
		http.Error(w, "learning path planning is not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	result, err := h.LearningPathPlanning.Get(
		r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), chi.URLParam(r, "pathID"),
	)
	if err != nil {
		writeExactLearningPathError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = writeInternalJSON(w, result)
}

func (h *Handler) ReplanLearningPath(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.LearningPathPlanning == nil {
		http.Error(w, "learning path planning is not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	var request exactLearningPathReplanRequest
	if err := decodeInternalJSON(w, r, &request); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	result, err := h.LearningPathPlanning.Replan(r.Context(), studentuc.LearningPathReplanInput{
		Schema: request.Schema, StudentID: chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), LearningPathID: chi.URLParam(r, "pathID"),
		PlanningRequestID: request.PlanningRequestID, IdempotencyKey: r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key"),
		CourseID: request.CourseID, GoalCode: request.GoalCode, CourseFingerprint: request.CourseFingerprint,
		PlannerPolicyVersion: request.PlannerPolicyVersion, ReasonCode: request.ReasonCode,
		ReasonSummary: request.ReasonSummary, ExpectedPathVersion: request.ExpectedVersion, DesiredItems: request.Items,
	})
	if err != nil {
		writeExactLearningPathError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = writeInternalJSON(w, result)
}

func (h *Handler) CompleteExactLearningPath(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.LearningPathPlanning == nil {
		http.Error(w, "learning path planning is not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	var request exactLearningPathNoGapRequest
	if err := decodeInternalJSON(w, r, &request); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	result, err := h.LearningPathPlanning.CompleteNoGap(r.Context(), studentuc.LearningPathNoGapInput{
		Schema: request.Schema, StudentID: chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), LearningPathID: chi.URLParam(r, "pathID"),
		PlanningRequestID: request.PlanningRequestID, IdempotencyKey: r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key"),
		CourseID: request.CourseID, GoalCode: request.GoalCode, CourseFingerprint: request.CourseFingerprint,
		PlannerPolicyVersion: request.PlannerPolicyVersion, ReasonCode: request.ReasonCode,
		ReasonSummary: request.ReasonSummary, ExpectedPathVersion: request.ExpectedVersion,
	})
	if err != nil {
		writeExactLearningPathError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = writeInternalJSON(w, result)
}

func writeExactLearningPathError(w http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation):
		http.Error(w, "invalid exact learning path request", http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict), errors.Is(err, domain.ErrInvalidStatus):
		http.Error(w, "exact learning path conflict", http.StatusConflict)
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound):
		http.Error(w, "learning path not found", http.StatusNotFound)
	default:
		http.Error(w, "exact learning path operation failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
	}
}

func writeInternalJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, payload any) error {
	return json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(payload)
}
